description.title: Description
enum: ACCL - Cancellation due to cancellation of the paying receiving user's account
CPCL - Cancellation due to closure of the receiving company
DCSD - Cancellation requested due to death of the paying user
ERSL - Cancellation requested by the receiving user or by their participant due to an error in the confirmation request
PCFD - Cancellation requested by the receiving user participant because the same recurrence was confirmed through another journey, for example, via QR code
SLCR - Cancellation requested by the receiving user
SLDB - Cancellation requested by the paying user
NRES - Cancellation requested by the receiving PSP due to lack of response to pain.009 within the regulatory period
OTHS - Requested by either the payer’s participant or the receiver’s participant for other reasons not specified in the previous categories
AC01 - Account not found or not belonging to the paying user
AC04 - The transactional account of the paying user is closed
AC06 - The transactional account of the paying user is blocked

AG12 - It is not allowed to send the request for recurrence authorization, recurrence cancellation, recurrence confirmation, or cancellation of pain.009 for a transactional account in the same institution or in a participant that uses the settlement service of the same settling participant in SPI.
AM05 - Recurrence confirmation request for periodic payments already previously confirmed or with status 'PDNG'
AP01 - Discrepancy in the field for updating recurrence data for periodic payments and the recurrence status for periodic payments (e.g., lack of synchronization)

AP02 - CPF/CNPJ of the paying user not found or different from the one in the original pain.009. Or, in the case of cancellation, the CPF/CNPJ of the paying user does not match the one contained in the recurrence data for periodic payments.
AP03 - Paying user's branch not found
AP04 - Invalid recurrence ID or does not match the original
AP05 - Inconsistent recurrence status for periodic payments

AP06 - CPF/CNPJ of the receiving user different from the one in the pain.009 or the payload. Or, in the case of cancellation, the CPF/CNPJ of the receiving user does not match the one contained in the recurrence data for periodic payments.
AP07 - Recurrence confirmation by the paying user performed after the expiration or cancellation of the confirmation request (pain.009)
AP08 - First immediate payment associated with the recurrence was not identified. (Valid only for Authorization Journey 3.)
AP09 - Recurrence confirmation request for periodic payments was not identified to enable its cancellation.
AP10 - CPF/CNPJ of the cancellation requester does not match the identification of the paying/receiving user or the paying/receiving PSP contained in the recurrence data for periodic payments.
AP11 - ISPB of the paying PSP diverges from the information contained in the recurrence for periodic payments
AP12 - ISPB of the receiving PSP diverges from the information contained in the recurrence for periodic payments
AP13 - Recurrence confirmation request for periodic payments rejected by the paying user due to non-recognition of the receiving user
AP14 - Recurrence confirmation request for periodic payments rejected by the paying user due to lack of interest in using Pix Automatic for the receiving user
AP15 - Recurrence confirmation request for periodic payments rejected by the paying user's participant who chose not to offer Pix Automatic usage for corporate clients
CH16 - Incorrect or incompatible message content with business rules.
DS27 - Participant is not registered or has not yet started operations in SPI.

MD01 - Recurrence object of the cancellation request does not exist. Should not be used for cancellation requests of pain.009 with status = 'PDNG'. That is, a recurrence with status = 'PDNG' should be considered as an existing recurrence.
MD20 - Recurrence object of the cancellation request has already expired.
RC09 - ISPB of the paying user's participant is invalid or non-existent.
RC10 - ISPB of the receiving user's participant is invalid or non-existent.
description.example: AC05 - Paying user's transactional account closed.
